faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve?

faq.q: How is a titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve is manufactured using Hot forging; CNC turning; Thread rolling (DIN 13-1 / ISO 965-2, 6g). Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve?
faq.a: Stainless steel (heavier, less fatigue life), aluminum (lower strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve?
faq.a: Titanium Pivot Bearing Spacer Sleeve components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium pivot bearing spacer sleeve?
faq.a: Common surface treatments include Passivation ASTM F86. These enhance corrosion resistance, wear properties, and aesthetic appearance.
